description: Agent Limits: submit a system’s limit-change process: each path that raises, loosens, suspends, lowers or tightens a limit, with who can take it (owner, admin, the agent, another agent, an automation or anyone), where the change is made, when a second party approves it (before it takes effect, after or never), the approver and when it is recorded, plus the limit changes recorded so far with who made them, who approved them and when each took effect, was approved and was recorded. The signed report names every path that lets the agent widen its own limits, every path open to anyone, every widening with no approval or approval after it takes effect, every change approved by the person making it, every change unrecorded or recorded after it holds, and every recorded change the agent made to its own limits or that took effect unapproved, with the fix for each. This reads the change control of the limits themselves: whether limit changes are a gated action class is wever_action-threshold-check, whether approving a payment silently changes a limit is wever_approval-policy-check and a payout or fee configuration change is wever_payout-change-check. Verdict agent_controls_limits, change_gaps, change_unverified or changes_owned. POST /api/limit-change-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-limits-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-limits/.

agent.description: The agent whose limits these are.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

paths.description: Each way a limit can be raised, loosened, suspended, lowered or tightened.

action.description: What the path does to a limit.

approval.description: When a second party approves the change.

recorded.description: When the change is written to a record.

via.description: Where the change is made, such as an admin console, a config file or a tool.

who.description: Who can take it, by name or role.

name: wever_limit-change-check
title: Limit change check
